design: Two output-cap configurations, three task-shaped templates, three repeats; independent acceptance uses new templates; end-to-end uses six new cases.
provider_model_version: catalog alias; immutable service snapshot unknown

schemas.coder_contract: Python source defining priority(f), no imports, executes on the supplied feature dictionary

selection_rule.minimum_coder_acceptance: 17/18 complete schema-valid responses and 17/18 safely executable programs
selection_rule.tie_break: Among configurations meeting both gates, select lower median billed tokens; if token usage is unavailable, select legacy_caps only if its completeness is strictly higher, otherwise expanded_caps.
selection_rule.if_no_configuration_passes: Use expanded_caps for end-to-end diagnostics, report calibration_not_ready, and do not start S1.

failure_policy: Each dispatched request consumes its slot. Preserve raw response, finish reason, usage and parser outcome. Do not retry an indeterminate request; stop the affected cohort and leave unstarted work explicit.
independence: No v1.2.3 TSP block, test data, hidden score, or future confirmation task is used. Calibration does not select by task quality.
claims: Engineering output-readiness calibration only; no search-quality, strategy, cross-task or doctoral-method superiority claim.
